cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model for Firebase AI Logic hybrid requests. In-app default: the SDK's hybrid default (gemini-3.5-flash-lite).

enable_cloud_review.description: Allow the interpretive design review to run in the cloud. When false the review uses the deterministic fallback.

on_device_first.description: Compact requests prefer Gemini Nano on device (PREFER_ON_DEVICE). False routes everything PREFER_IN_CLOUD.

stream_rationale.description: Stream the design rationale with generateContentStream.

max_plan_px.description: Longest edge (px) used when rasterising uploaded drawings for detection.

crit_room_live.description: Enable live presence and camera follow in the crit room.

announcement.description: Banner text shown to every open session in real time. Empty hides the banner.

limited_use_tokens.description: Single-use App Check tokens for AI requests (a reCAPTCHA check on every request).
